description: Convert HTML to Markdown (CommonMark + GitHub tables), dropping scripts and styles. Operations: "convert" — Convert an HTML page or fragment to Markdown: headings, lists, links, images, code blocks, tables and blockquotes.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: The HTML to convert (a whole page or a fragment).

operation.description: convert — Convert an HTML page or fragment to Markdown: headings, lists, links, images, code blocks, tables and blockquotes.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

baseUrl.description: Absolute URL to resolve relative links and images against. Used by: convert.

images.description: Keep images as ![alt](src); false writes only their alt text. Used by: convert.

scope.description: main: convert only the first <main> (or <article>) when the page has one; all: the whole body. Used by: convert.

name: html-markdown
title: HTML to Markdown
